данные.точная_цитата_уточнения: Ya voobsjhe dumal na FUMA uzhe translyator i napishem s FUMA na Swift.

изменение_существующего_требования.owner: FUM requirements; FUMA parent thread 01a1698f-bb98-7691-b1c1-31ec737ed070 appoints the FUMA AOT implementation owner
изменение_существующего_требования.statement: For an explicitly bounded supported subset of FUMA graphs, FUMA deterministically lowers graph/string expressions to standalone Swift ahead of time through a translator defined in FUMA. This is not JIT execution, a wrapper around a prewritten Swift translator, or translation of the whole FUMA language. A Swift translator/reference may serve as bootstrap, but its existence does not establish a ready FUMA-defined translator.
изменение_существующего_требования.добавленный_критерий: The translator definition is written in FUMA and is itself invoked to generate Swift for the bounded supported graph; wrapping or calling a prewritten Swift translator does not satisfy this criterion.
изменение_существующего_требования.evidence_boundary: PR-437 reports a narrow passing AOT compile/run slice in its current draft body. That slice and any Swift reference/bootstrap do not establish that the FUMA-defined translator is ready. This requirement does not establish a full-language translation, general FUMA runtime, broad suite, merge, ROOT acceptance, or the separate reproducible Swift-build and symmetric model escalation/de-escalation processes (policy package owner: pravila; pilot owner: arkhitektura).
